description: sqli-fixable LoginServlet: the fixture's regression test, renamed *SecurityTest as the testgen schema requires (fails on the vulnerable code, passes after fix/prepared-statement.patch)

json.expected_failure: attacker-controlled username reached the SQL text
json.rationale: A child-first class loader gives LoginServlet a recording Db, so the SQL text is captured on both the Statement and the PreparedStatement path; the payload must never appear in the SQL text.
